fields.title: Minimize Collection
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: A food delivery registration form collects: name, phone, email, date of birth, gender, address, workplace, how you heard about us. What to remove and what to replace?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: remove date of birth (unless there is a specific function), gender, workplace. Make email optional — phone is already there. 'How you heard' is not personal data, but unnecessary friction at registration; move it to a survey later. Address — not at registration, but at the first order: it is not needed before the order. Name and phone remain. Takeaway: ask for each field what function uses it today.
